versions.changelog:
- Expanded and clarified usage scenarios, including strong recommendations for music/lifestyle content and notes on other article types.
- Added bilingual (中文 & English) intro and usage guidance, emphasizing default color palette and component relevance.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.
- Improved documentation and component descriptions in SKILL.md for better readability and applicability.
- No changes to core formatting logic or HTML output.

WeChat MP Formatter 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Converts articles into WeChat Official Account (公众号)–compatible HTML, preserving all styles when copy-pasted into the editor.
- Provides a component library for styled elements: music cards, lyric quotes, highlights, key sentences, interactive prompts, headings, paragraphs, and inline emphasis.
- Enforces strict compatibility rules for WeChat editor (e.g., using <section> and inline styles, avoiding <div> and flexbox).
- Uses a base HTML template with built-in "copy" functionality for easy transfer to the WeChat editor.
- Offers detailed usage instructions, CSS compatibility notes, typography guidelines, and a warm-tone color palette.
